description:
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {5}, casting Scampering Scorcher from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Scampering Scorcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Elemental creature tokens and giving Elementals you control haste until end of turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing Scampering Scorcher and two Elementals, adding six {C}.
Repeat.
